2026-10-12-widget-actions-own-behavior.message: Let sidebar widget actions and update phases say what they do

2026-10-12-agent-messages-own-behavior.message: Let agent messages and tool options say what they do

2026-10-12-core-kinds-own-behavior.message: Let core kinds say what each of them does

2026-10-12-cloud-sync-steps-own-behavior.message: Let each iCloud sync step take itself

2026-10-12-core-changes-follow-themselve.message: Let each core change say who follows it

2026-10-12-page-edge-objects-own-behavio.message: Let page and engine-edge objects carry what they do

2026-10-12-settings-own-behavior.message: Let settings pages, permissions and requests say what they do

2026-10-12-setup-steps-own-behavior.message: Let setup steps, outcomes and lessons say what they show and do

2026-10-12-studio-and-choices-own-behavi.message: Let studio steps, emblems and small choices carry their own behavior

2026-10-12-sidebar-drop-targets-own-beha.message: Let sidebar drop targets and zones say what they take

2026-10-12-sidebar-lift-previews-own-beh.message: Let sidebar lift previews size and place themselves

2026-10-12-sidebar-pointer-actions-own-b.message: Let sidebar pointer and row actions say what they do

2026-10-12-download-actions-own-behavior.message: Let download actions, destinations and feedback say what they do

2026-10-12-transient-requests-own-behavi.message: Let transient requests, lease dispositions and pulls say what they do

2026-10-12-mobile-layout-own-behavior.message: Let window sizes, sidebar toggles and Settings styles carry what they do

2026-10-12-widget-kinds-own-rules.message: Let widget kinds, deck directions and gesture axes carry what they do

2026-10-12-peek-measures-own-rules.message: Let Peek's views and the card arrangement carry their own measures

2026-10-12-mobile-layout-own-rules.message: Let window sizes, viewports and pagers carry the iPhone and iPad layout

2026-10-12-mobile-platform-own-rules.message: Let the iPhone app's platform pieces hold their own rules

2026-10-12-core-query-answers-own-rules.message: Let core queries and page values carry the rules that judge them

2026-10-12-tokens-and-shell-own-rules.message: Let design tokens, Space colors, settings values and the Mac shell keep their own rules

2026-10-12-link-preferences-judge-themse.message: Let link preferences, routes and schemes judge themselves

2026-10-12-sync-records-decide-conflicts.message: Let sync records, addresses and reasons decide their conflicts

2026-10-12-download-media-launch-answers.message: Let download, media and launch questions answer from their facts

2026-10-12-pages-history-spaces-own-rule.message: Let pages, history, Spaces and brandings keep their own rules

2026-10-12-import-setup-repair-own-steps.message: Let import reviews, setups and session repair carry their own steps

2026-10-12-queries-answer-without-app.message: Let each query say how it answers without an app

2026-10-12-unsupported-address-rejection.message: Refuse an address no Space holds as an unsupported address

2026-10-12-branding-makes-imported-looks.message: Let a branding make the looks imported Spaces wear

2026-10-12-sidebar-chrome-tabs-own-rules.message: Let sidebar rows, chrome, tabs, splits and Spaces carry their own rules

2026-10-12-forwarders-retired.message: Ask each rule's owner directly instead of through old forwarders

2026-10-12-entitlement-extension-strip-o.message: Let the iCloud service and extension strip views keep their own measures

2026-10-12-navigation-decisions-answer-w.message: Let each navigation decision answer WebKit itself

2026-10-12-commands-prompts-swipes-say-w.message: Let engine commands, pending prompts and swipe decisions say what they do

2026-10-12-cloud-receipts-note-themselve.message: Let the core's answers to the cloud transport note what they tell it

2026-10-12-iphone-welcome-card-width.message: The welcome card on iPhone lines up with the rest of the welcome page.

2026-10-12-refuse-unexpected-edits-inste.message: Crest no longer quits when it can’t make an edit, such as one on a tab that just closed or a change only a Space’s owner may make.

2026-10-12-prompt-hosts-answer-every-que.message: Every place that shows Crest's questions now handles each kind of question explicitly.

2026-10-12-refused-engine-report-safe.message: A page reporting something Crest can’t use no longer closes the app.

2026-10-12-concrete-pane-views.message: Keep settings, studio and lesson panes as concrete views

2026-10-12-extension-files-own-one-type.message: Give each extension file one owner type

2026-10-12-sidebar-surface-material.message: Choose how much the sidebar’s tabs, folders and bars let the background show through, from Ultra Thin to Ultra Thick, in Look and Feel settings. Pinned tabs now sit closer under the address bar.

2026-10-12-sidebar-layer-shapes.message: Tabs, folders, Split Views, pinned tabs and the address bar now share one shape and spacing that follows your corner setting.

2026-10-12-floating-surface-material.message: Site Controls, Peek, notices and other floating panels use the same material as the sidebar.

2026-10-12-capsule-corners.message: With Capsule corners, single tabs are capsules, and Split Views and open folders round their corners to match.

2026-10-12-site-controls-tile-fill.message: Give tiles inside material panels a fixed fill

crest-08-agents-palette-settings.message: Crest 0.8 lets coding agents use Crest as their browser on Mac, brings a rebuilt command palette and Settings, imports from many more browsers, and makes the sidebar quicker and more consistent.

pinned-tab-status-badge-corner.message: On pinned tabs, the sound and sharing badge sits in the tile’s bottom corner instead of over the site icon, so the icon is easy to click.

site-controls-extension-menu-stays-open.message: Right-clicking an extension in Site Controls shows its menu without closing Site Controls.

pin-layout-honors-chosen-columns.message: Pins fill each row to the number chosen in Settings, as far as the sidebar width allows, instead of evening out the rows.

web-inspector-shortcut-toggles.message: Pressing Option-Command-I again closes the Web Inspector or Chromium DevTools instead of leaving it open.

find-close-returns-page-focus.message: Closing find in page returns the keyboard to the page, including a page in Peek, so arrow keys and Space scroll right away.

sidebar-hides-when-pointer-leaves-window.message: A hidden sidebar that slides out at the window edge now hides again when the pointer moves on to another app.

sidebar-offscreen-page-resizing.message: Showing and hiding the sidebar is smoother when several Spaces are open.

space-switch-keeps-sliding.message: Switching Spaces again before the slide finishes keeps sliding toward the next Space instead of jumping to it.

window-controls-follow-sidebar-side.message: When the sidebar moves to the other side of the window, the window buttons travel with it instead of arriving first.

smoother-live-resize.message: Resizing the window, a split or the sidebar is smoother.

sidebar-utility-shortcuts.message: The History, Archive and Downloads shortcuts open and close their list, showing the sidebar for the moment when it is hidden, and Command-F searches the list that is open.

translation-download-languages-no-crash.message: Download Languages in Page Translation settings opens language downloads without Crest quitting.

chromium-whole-page-translation.message: Translate whole pages on device in Chromium too, with the same translation toolbar, automatic translation and Show Original as WebKit pages.

translation-unsupported-page-language.message: Pages in more languages, such as Swedish, now translate, and a page in a language Apple Translation doesn’t support says so instead of offering a translation that fails.

cross-space-link-tab-activation.message: Opening a link in another Space shows the link there instead of the Start Page.

palette-control-a-e-line-edges.message: Control-A and Control-E move to the start and end of the line in the address bar instead of jumping between result sections.

sidebar-stays-hidden-after-focus-moves-a.message: A hidden sidebar no longer slides back out on its own when you click into another app or another Mac with the pointer at the window edge.

page-commands-follow-quick-window.message: Back, Reload, Find, Zoom, Copy Page Link, Print and the other page commands work in a Quick Window.

peek-close-returns-keyboard.message: Closing a Peek gives the keyboard back to the page underneath, so the arrow keys and Space scroll it again without a click.

quick-window-page-tools.message: Translate, Reader, content blocking, the Web Inspector and moving a page to the other engine now work on a Quick Window’s page.

space-switch-wraps-around.message: Next Space and Previous Space slide around from the last Space to the first, and back, instead of jumping.

space-slide-survives-sidebar-toggle.message: A Space switch keeps sliding when you show or hide the sidebar during it, instead of jumping to the end.

settings-controls-take-clicks-on-macos-2.message: On macOS 26, switches, pickers and the house choices in Settings take every click instead of ignoring clicks after the first.

update-restart-quits-crest.message: Restart and Update quits Crest and installs the update instead of waiting until you quit, and Quit in the Dock works again, even after another app has used AppleScript with Crest.

quit-after-space-deletion-fails.message: Crest quits instead of waiting indefinitely when a Space couldn’t be fully deleted, and tries deleting that Space again the next time it opens.

chromium-upstream-155-0-8059-39-1-1-6271.message: Chromium is updated to 155.0.8059.39 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.

http-dead-link-crash.message: Opening an http:// address that can’t be reached shows Crest’s error page instead of closing Crest.

link-route-exact-site-name.message: A link route set to “Is Exactly” with just a site’s name, such as docs.google.com, now matches that site’s home page, and Links settings say that routes apply to links from other apps.

link-route-address-field-editable.message: A link route’s address field takes clicks and typing, with “example.com” shown as a hint inside it instead of a fixed label beside it.

settings-narrow-window-sidebar-clicks.message: In a narrow window, a Space’s Crest Studio no longer covers the Settings sidebar, so its search field and Space buttons take clicks again.

local-addresses-open-over-http.message: Typing a local address such as 192.168.0.1 or printer.local opens it over http, as other browsers do, and an address typed with http:// always opens over http.

tab-title-after-failed-load.message: When a page can’t be opened, its tab in the sidebar shows the site it tried to open instead of the previous page’s title.

core-owned-tab-history.message: The core keeps each page's back and forward history, with an identity per entry that engines report and traverse by.

core-history-load-identity-on-failure.message: A page the core asks to load in place of a history entry gives up that entry's identity when the load fails or is cancelled, so a later page never takes it.

history-across-engine-moves.message: Back and Forward keep working after a page opens in another engine, and take each page back to the engine it was shown in.

history-refused-step-keeps-site-engine.message: A step through history the engine refuses no longer keeps a later visit to that address on the same engine instead of the one chosen for the site.

history-across-engines-after-relaunch.message: Tabs keep their back and forward history across engines after Crest relaunches, and a duplicated tab keeps it too.

history-kept-before-engine-state.message: A tab keeps its history across engines after a relaunch or when duplicated even before its page has any engine state to keep, and a long history no longer loses a run the page left on its oldest entry.

chromium-form-submit-autofill-save-crash.message: Crest no longer quits when you submit a form containing a payment card or address.

setup-full-screen-look-choice.message: Setup on the Mac fills the screen and asks whether your Spaces wear Crest's heraldic banners and crests or a modern gradient and icon, then carries that look through importing, reviewing and making your Spaces yours.

setup-import-read-cancel.message: While setup reads a browser you chose to import, the page says so where Continue was and offers Cancel, so a slow or stuck read no longer leaves setup looking stuck with every button disabled.

address-bar-selects-url-on-tap.message: Tapping the address bar on iPhone selects the whole address, so typing replaces it or you can copy it right away.

mobile-cross-site-download-test-wait.message: The iPhone and iPad test of a download from another site waits as long as WebKit takes in the Simulator to start it, so it no longer fails after other tests have run.

mobile-full-screen-video-shows.message: On iPhone and iPad, a video a site shows full screen, such as Reddit's, fills the screen instead of going black, and the page is back when you leave full screen.

sync-default-search-and-crest-passwords.message: A new iPhone or iPad that syncs with iCloud searches with the default your other devices' Spaces follow instead of keeping Google, turning Crest Passwords on or off for a Space reaches your other devices, and Settings says which search and password choices stay on each device.

share-sheet-open-links.message: On iPhone and iPad, Crest appears in the share sheet, so a link shared from another app, or the first link in shared text, opens in Crest.

appearance-preview-concentric-page-corne.message: On iPhone and iPad, the page in the Appearance window preview rounds its corners with the preview's, so the window border keeps its width all the way around.

ios-icon-tinted-clear-background.message: With tinted or clear app icons on iPhone, iPad and Mac, Crest's icon sits on the same tinted or glass background as other apps instead of a flat gray one.

mobile-edge-swipe-back-forward.message: On iPhone and iPad, swipe in from a page's left edge to go back and from its right edge to go forward. With the sidebar hidden on iPad, a swipe in from the top or bottom of its edge still brings the sidebar back.

setup-color-strip-clip.message: In setup, the color and emblem rows on Make it yours stay inside their panel while you scroll them, instead of drawing over the window preview.

iphone-duo-layout.message: On iPhone Duo, Crest's controls move to the side bar where iOS puts them, pages use the outer display's full width, the open display's page and sidebar reach its edges, and folded like a book the sidebar and page, or a Split View's two pages, each take one side of the fold.

no-room-for-hidden-keyboard.message: On iPhone and iPad, Crest no longer leaves an empty band at the bottom of the window for a keyboard that isn't on screen.

history-swipe-from-page-frame.message: On iPhone and iPad, a swipe to go back or forward can also start on the frame around the page, where a finger reaching for the edge of the screen lands.

sidebar-keeps-space-across-displays.message: On iPhone Duo, opening or closing the phone keeps the sidebar and its colors on the Space you're in instead of showing your first Space.

split-view-shows-every-page-on-open.message: On iPhone Duo, a Split View made on the outer display shows both of its pages when you open the phone, instead of one staying blank until you tap it.

narrower-default-sidebar-ipad.message: On iPad and iPhone Duo, the sidebar starts narrower, leaving more of the window to the page.

quick-window-card-fits-screen.message: On iPhone and iPad, a Quick Window no longer leaves an empty band above it, and on iPad a Quick Window or Peek beside the sidebar stays on screen instead of running off its edge.

dismissed-address-shows-page.message: On iPhone and in a Mac Quick Window, leaving the address bar without going anywhere, by tapping or clicking away or pressing Escape, puts the page's address back instead of what you typed.

sidebar-list-reaches-bottom-corner.message: On iPad and iPhone Duo, the sidebar's tabs scroll on to the bottom of the screen and into its corner instead of stopping short above it.

address-bar-swipes-through-tabs.message: On iPhone, swiping left or right on the address bar moves through the tabs of your Space in sidebar order, and the page slides along with your finger. In a Split View, the other cards sit beside the address bar, and the swipe moves card by card before carrying on to the next tab.

chromium-upstream-155-0-8059-84-1-1-721f.message: Chromium is updated to 155.0.8059.84 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.

chromium-emudhra-certificates-distrusted.message: Pages that run in Chromium no longer trust certificates from the compromised eMudhra certificate authorities, matching Chrome.

crest-0-8-50-chromium-security-setup-tra.message: Crest 0.8.50 updates Chromium with its latest security fixes and stops trusting the compromised eMudhra certificate authorities, rebuilds setup on the Mac, translates whole pages in Chromium, and fixes several crashes and problems quitting.

upload-ios-cloud-archives-without-ad-hoc.message: Upload iOS Cloud archives to TestFlight from the App Store export when the ad hoc export fails

appearance-light-dark-follow-system.message: Keep Crest light or dark, or let it follow macOS, in Settings › Appearance. Spaces can also dim their colors in dark.

background-launch-for-connected-tools.message: Connected tools can start Crest in the background without taking focus.

space-neutral-look.message: Spaces can start from a Neutral look: a plain gray sidebar with a fine grain that goes light or dark with the system. A Space's text color can follow the system's appearance too.

mcp-native-browser-tools.message: Connected tools can search history, use search providers, and open windows in allowed Spaces, and delete an address from a Space’s history once you agree, while private tabs remain inaccessible.

sidebar-edge-reveals-for-moving-pointer.message: The sidebar no longer slides back out under a pointer that is just resting at the screen edge, such as one left there by Universal Control. It reveals when you move the pointer to the edge.

sidebar-hover-in-full-screen.message: Settings > Appearance can keep the sidebar hover area working while a video plays full screen, so the sidebar floats over the video when the pointer reaches the edge of the screen.

space-slide-continues-forward.message: Pressing Next or Previous Space again while a Space is still sliding carries the slide on from where it is, without stepping back first, including around the ends.

agents-pointer-activity-and-questions.message: An agent’s pointer shows where it works on a page, Settings › Agents lists what each agent did, Stop All Agents stops every agent at once, and Crest asks before an agent opens a window. Agents can also read a page’s text and answer its dialogs.

temporary-sidebar-interruptible-animatio.message: The sidebar hides and shows more smoothly, the History, Archive and Downloads selector closes back to its button, and History, Archive or Downloads opened over a hidden sidebar stays open while you use the page.

space-icon-size-setting.message: The Space icons at the bottom of the sidebar shrink so more Spaces fit without scrolling. To keep one size instead, turn off Fit Space icons to sidebar in Appearance settings and choose it with the slider.

space-lock-stays-off.message: Turning off a Space’s lock in Settings now sticks after one Touch ID or password check, instead of the lock coming back. With iCloud sync, turning a lock on or off reaches your other devices too, even where the Space is locked, without unlocking it there first. If a lock can’t change, Crest says so at the top of the window.

sidebar-shift-click-selects-range.message: Shift-clicking a tab in the sidebar selects every tab between the active tab and the one you clicked, instead of only adding that tab like Command-click.

palette-search-typed-address.message: The command palette offers to search for a typed or pasted address as well as open it.

capture-page-shortcut.message: On Mac, Capture Page in the Page menu and the command palette lets you drag over part of a page to copy it as an image. Its shortcut is Command-Shift-2.

paste-and-match-style-web-pages.message: Paste and Match Style now works in editable web content, from the Edit menu, its shortcut and the page's right-click menu.

pins-stretch-to-fill-row.message: Pins can stretch to fill the width of a row that isn't full, so an uneven number of pins no longer leaves empty space.

mouse-swipe-buttons-switch-spaces-over-s.message: Mouse Back and Forward buttons set up as swipes in Logitech Options+ switch Spaces when the pointer is over the sidebar, as other mice do.

webkit-first-page-under-page-colour.message: On Mac, a page shown in WebKit now uses its own background colour when you scroll past its edges, starting with the first page a tab loads.

memory-warning-unloads-one-tab.message: On iPhone and iPad, running low on memory now unloads one background tab instead of several, so fewer tabs reload when you go back to them.

remove-dead-sidebar-drop-indicators.message: Remove the sidebar's drop-indicator code, which never drew anything since the in-place reorder replaced it.

slim-test-suite.message: Trim the test suites to the contracts that can break silently: persistence, sync, privacy, security, extensions, input routing and shared session rules.

fold-one-sided-platform-seams.message: Share the window colour, sheet sizing and text field settings between Mac and iPhone, and drop platform stand-ins that did nothing.

session-rules-on-session-state.message: Keep the core's Space lookups, history expiry and seed repair in one place each, on the session and its Spaces.

remove-unsent-core-intents.message: Remove core commands the app never sends: cancelling a close check, moving a whole split and removing history by date range.

remove-page-layer-leftovers.message: Remove page plumbing nothing used: a new-tab callback no page called, an empty navigation hook and stand-in protocols with a single implementation.

emoji-catalog-resource.message: Bundle the emoji picker's catalog as a data file instead of compiling it into the app, which speeds up builds.

core-single-spellings.message: Keep one definition each in the core for the stored-date epoch, ordered device-store writes and known URL schemes, and show a sync save failure's own message.

shared-notification-delivery.message: Show web and extension notifications through one shared path that checks permission, trims long text and withdraws stale ones.

layer-direction-moves.message: Move the Space selector out of the design system into Spaces, settings layout into the design system and page state models next to the page.

remove-test-orphans.message: Remove the in-app performance harness and other code only retired tests and tools used.

shared-webkit-page-handling.message: Share WebKit link decisions, sign-in and certificate challenges, permission requests and script dialogs between Mac and iPhone pages.

ipad-menu-from-command-table.message: Build the iPad keyboard menu from the same command table the command palette uses, with the same items, shortcuts and enabled states.

shared-sidebar-page-binding.message: Bind the sidebar to a window's pages once for Mac and iPhone, with the Mac adding tab sharing and audio.

mobile-window-page-store.message: Set up an iPhone or iPad window's pages in one place, so the app and each window wire sign-ins, links and Peeks the same way.

shared-script-message-proxy.message: Use one message proxy for every page script bridge instead of a copy per bridge.

shared-sidebar-drag-state.message: Track a dragged sidebar folder or tab with one drag session type instead of two copies.

shared-drag-session-end.message: End an iPhone or iPad sidebar drag through one shared step once the system reports it finished.

background-link-opening-notice.message: Opening a link in a background tab now shows a brief confirmation at the top of the window.

smooth-appearance-previews.message: Dragging an Appearance setting, such as the window border, material, Space icon size or the tab and address field colors, no longer slows the whole app down.

menus-use-command-names.message: The Space menu and the iPhone page menu now name and show commands the way the menu bar does, such as Clear Unpinned Tabs and Show History.

localized-new-folder-name.message: A folder you make without naming it is called New Folder in the app's language, not always in English.

engine-page-answers-requests.message: The Chromium engine's pages answer the app's page requests themselves, through one path instead of a forwarding handler each.

engine-extension-profile-check.message: Decide in one place whether a Chromium extension may run in a private window's profile.

staged-link-uuid.message: Carry a staged link's identity as a UUID rather than as text both engines parse back.

synced-visit-field-names.message: Synced visits spell their fields from the one table the stored session uses.

synced-folder-field-names.message: Synced folders spell their fields from one table.

synced-tab-field-names.message: Synced tabs and archived tabs spell their fields from one table.

synced-space-field-names.message: Synced Spaces and splits spell their fields from one table.

sync-record-envelope.message: Read and write a sync record's envelope in one place.

independent-search-provider-triggers.message: Choose in Search settings whether a space after a search shortcut chooses its provider, with or without a $ first, separately from Tab.

sync-merge-save-freeze.message: Crest no longer freezes when an iCloud sync arrives while it’s saving a change, such as deleting a Space, moving or closing several tabs, or importing from another browser.

recent-tab-switcher-previews.message: Holding Control-Tab on the Mac shows previews of your five most recent tabs in the window, so you can pick one and let go to switch. Control-Shift-Tab goes the other way, and you can turn the previews off in Settings.

split-view-one-recent-tab.message: Control-Tab treats a Split View as one tab, so it reaches your other tabs instead of only switching between the two pages of the split.

ipv6-saved-password-origin.message: Passwords saved for an IPv6 address load again, and one saved password Crest can't read no longer hides a Space's other passwords. Settings can remove it.

escaped-address-saved-password-origin.message: Passwords imported from another browser are no longer saved for the wrong site when the address contains escaped characters.

import-invalid-ip-address-passwords.message: Importing a password file now lists rows with a malformed IP address as invalid instead of saving passwords that could never fill.

imported-ip-address-passwords-fill.message: Imported passwords for sites at an IP address written in a long or unusual form, such as 127.1, now fill on that site and merge with passwords already saved for it.

find-shift-return-previous-match.message: Pressing Shift-Return in Find moves to the previous match.

toggle-command-bar-shortcut.message: Pressing Command-T while the command bar is open closes it.

keyboard-tab-keeps-the-space-on-ipad.message: On iPad with a keyboard, pressing Tab in a webpage's form no longer switches to another Space.

floating-sidebar-exit-margin.message: The floating sidebar stays open when the pointer drifts just past its edge, and hides once the pointer moves further into the page.

quick-window-space-switcher.message: Click the Space in a Quick Window’s address bar to switch Spaces. The page reloads in the Space you choose, with that Space’s cookies and passwords, and Crest remembers the choice for that site.

quick-window-address-drag-selects-text.message: Dragging across a Quick Window’s address field selects its text instead of moving the window. The space around the field still moves the window.

downloads-drag-out-as-files.message: Finished downloads can be dragged out of the Downloads list and dropped into Finder or another app, like any file.

sidebar-lists-button-choice.message: Right-click the lists button at the bottom of the sidebar to choose whether it opens Archive, History or Downloads in the Space you are in.

start-page-command-t-focus.message: On a Start Page, Command-T closes an open command bar and puts the cursor back in the Start Page field.

clear-one-site-cookies-or-cache.message: Site Controls can clear the open site's cookies or its cache. Clearing cookies signs you out of the site and removes everything it stored in that Space, including service workers and what sites embedded in it stored there. Both are also in the command palette and, on iPhone and iPad, the page menu.

space-website-data-settings.message: Each Space's Privacy settings list the sites that keep data, with Remove and Remove All, and can clear history, cookies and site data, and cached files from the last hour up to all time.

website-data-locked-space-guard.message: Listing or clearing a locked Space's website data is refused until it is unlocked, Remove All clears every site's data in the Space, and the site commands on iPhone and iPad need a page that shows a site.
